summary: Bulk procurement + vendor onboarding: security tooling SaaS seats (SAML + SSO enablement)
description:
Issue summary:
Security team needs to purchase and onboard multiple seats for a set of SaaS tools required for a new detection engineering pod (hired start of Q2). This ticket covers procurement, vendor onboarding (SAML/SSO setup with Okta), license assignment workflow, and completion of vendor security questionnaire where required.

Impact:
- 6 engineers (Detection & Threat Infra) cannot be granted full access to the new SSO-protected tooling until licenses are procured and vendor SSO is configured.
- Onboarding delay will push planned runbook work and SIEM ingestion tasks by ~2–3 weeks.

Requested items (detailed):
1) Rapid7 InsightVM: 6 full analyst seats + 1 admin seat (12-month term).
2) Fugue (cloud security posture): 6 seats (annual) — vendor requires company IA questionnaire and SOC2 evidence.
3) Extra Okta app connections: add FugaCorp (Fugue) and Rapid7 to Okta allowlist and configure SCIM provisioning where supported.
4) Centralized billing: combine with existing Security stack billing where possible; provide invoice vs PO option.

Business justification:
- Detection team capacity expanding; licenses required to run scheduled scans, investigations, and automate remediation workflows tied to our Dedicated tenants. Tools are pre-approved by Security leadership and were included in hiring ramp plan.

Budget / PO info:
- Cost estimate (vendor quotes requested): Rapid7 ~$9,600/yr (6 seats + admin license), Fugue ~$7,200/yr. Total est ~$16,800/yr.
- Funding: 2026-Security-Headcount operating budget (code SEC-OPS-26). Request finance to approve PO issuance or to confirm chargeback to existing cost center.

Timing / urgency:
- Desired provisioning window: by 2026-03-12 to align with new hire start date 2026-03-15.

Acceptance criteria:
- Purchase order issued and invoice approved by finance.
- Vendor onboarding checklist complete: signed DPA/PO (if required), SOC2 report provided, vendor contacts added to vendor registry.
- Okta SAML app created for each vendor and SCIM provisioning enabled where supported.
- Seats assigned to users listed below and test user authentication completed.

Users to provision (initial):
- emma.li@redwood.ai
- rafael.gomez@redwood.ai
- jamal.hart@redwood.ai
- lina.park@redwood.ai
- oliver.nguyen@redwood.ai
- becky.singh@redwood.ai

Steps to reproduce / action items (next steps):
1) Procurement: create RFP/email to vendors for formal quotes and confirm bulk pricing + term.
2) Legal/Security: send vendor security questionnaire template to Fugue; request SOC2 Type II and encryption at rest docs.
3) Identity: create Okta application placeholders and request vendor SSO metadata URLs.
4) Finance: prepare PO and confirm whether purchasing card can be used for initial term if PO timeline slips.
5) Ops: after license purchase, assign seats and log provisioning steps in Confluence onboarding page.

Supporting links / attachments:
- Confluence onboarding checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Sec/Vendor+Onboarding+Checklist
- Vendor contacts (initial outreach): Rapid7 sales rep — j.smith@rapid7.com; Fugue sales — sales@fugue.co
- Security budget code doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Fin/SEC-OPS-26

Notes:
- Fugue requires a filled security questionnaire before quotes can be finalized. Legal expects to review DPA. Please loop in legal@redwood.ai early.
